subject.title: Modular Dashboard: agent-composable Control UI workspaces (tracking)

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor the modular dashboard workspace stack as a bundled Control UI/product direction, and what storage plus custom-widget security boundaries must it satisfy before merge?
rationale: The request adds a new default-facing dashboard model, persistent dashboard state, Gateway RPC/event surfaces, agent tools, and untrusted browser widget execution; those are product and security choices that code inspection alone cannot approve.

options.title: Review and sponsor the stack
options.body: Proceed through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101094, https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101097, and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101098 in order, requiring storage-policy, upgrade, proof, and security-boundary fixes before merge.

options.title: Narrow to core seams only
options.body: Accept only generic plugin/API gaps maintainers want and ask dashboard-specific widgets/workspaces to remain external or ClawHub-hosted until separately sponsored.

options.title: Defer the direction
options.body: Leave the feature unimplemented for now or close the linked PR stack if maintainers decide bundled agent-composable dashboards are outside current roadmap scope.

recommendation.title: Review and sponsor the stack
recommendation.body: Proceed through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101094, https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101097, and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101098 in order, requiring storage-policy, upgrade, proof, and security-boundary fixes before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current-main owner signal for both the Control UI direction and the plugin-tab seam this proposal builds on.
